# The Right Hairstyles

> > AI-powered hairstyle discovery platform featuring virtual try-on technology, comprehensive styling guides, and curated galleries for men and women.

The Right Hairstyles has been helping users find their perfect look since 2013, combining an AI Hairstyle Changer tool with expert editorial content. The site offers 100+ virtual hairstyle options, detailed technique guides (like balayage), and extensive photo galleries organized by style, age, and gender.

- Women's hairstyles

- [AI Hairstyle Changer: Virtual Haircut Generator with 100+ Styles](https://therighthairstyles.com): Homepage featuring AI hairstyle try-on tool with 100+ styles from one selfie

## Hair Styling Guides & Tutorials

- [Balayage 101: The Fullest Guide to Balayage Hair](https://therighthairstyles.com/balayage-hair): Comprehensive guide to balayage technique with 20+ types and colorist tips
- [Should I Get Bangs? Top Tips and a Quiz to Help You Decide](https://therighthairstyles.com/decide-if-you-should-get-bangs-or-not): Interactive guide with quiz and AI tool to help decide on getting bangs
- [The Guide to 7 Natural Hair Lighteners and Adding DIY Highlights](https://therighthairstyles.com/natural-hair-lighteners): Tutorial on natural hair lightening methods including honey, cinnamon, and UV
- [How To Choose Your Prom Hairstyle, Is DIY Prom Hair Worth Trying, and Answers to Your Other Questions](https://therighthairstyles.com/prom-hairstyle-guide): Prom hairstyle guide with FAQ covering up/down styles and DIY options
